[[File:Rear_Admiral_Chiraneau_TCGTFM.png|thumb|right|250px|Rear Admiral [[Chiraneau/Legends|Chiraneau]]]]

'''Rear Admiral''' was a naval line rank, usually the lowest level of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] in a fleet barring the simple address of Admiral, and the counterpart to the Army rank of [[Major General]]. The next rank up in seniority was [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]], while the rank below was [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]]. There is also some evidence for a semi-formal subordinate grade of [[Brevet]]-Admirals, necessitated by the vast expansion of military command responsibilities under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and later during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

Within the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], Rear Admirals held a position of [[systems admiral]] (also known as commodore) when they commanded a [[systems force]]. However, most systems forces contained only one [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] and Rear Admirals shared both positions of systems admiral and squadron [[Commander/Legends|commander]]. Rear Admiral ranked above [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]], and below [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]]. The rank was the equivalent of [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Starfighter Corps]] [[General/Legends|General]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

The title existed in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] at least as early as the [[Mandalorian Wars]], when [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Saul Karath]] was promoted to Rear Admiral in [[3963 BBY]] after the [[Battle of Vanquo]].

One Imperial Rear Admiral, [[Michael Unther]], was promoted to Rear Admiral after retiring from active duty: somewhat bizarrely, he had previously been the commanding Admiral of a [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]].
